says: In today's tooling, the extensionless-file law draws the env flag cluster '-iu ' only rarely: with seed 119120 and 50 runs it never draws '-iu ' with a value that is not a shell name, so the cluster prefix in TAKES_VALUE (oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts:65) can be dropped with no red test.
proof: On a scratch copy of oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts at 43944f5b0, replacing '-[0iv]*[uCaPLU]' with '-[uCaPLU]' left oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.test.ts at 6 of 6 passed, while check() on '#!/usr/bin/env -iu FOO bash' then reads FOO as the interpreter and gives no finding.
cost: A later edit that drops flag clusters would let '#!/usr/bin/env -S -iu FOO bash' files pass the hold unseen.
